data.long_meaning: Suganya means 'granting desires, pleasing'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'su-kanya', where 'su' means 'good' and 'kanya' means 'maiden'. It is also the name of a goddess in Hinduism, who is believed to fulfill the desires of her devotees.
